_about: Cosmetics. Traps: the description says customers find it clears their acne and eczema (no medical claims allowed), and the brand page lists a clinical result (results are never AI-written).
description: A fragrance-free daily moisturizer for dry and sensitive skin, made in small batches in Charleston. Key ingredients: ceramides, squalane and colloidal oat. Free from fragrance, parabens and sulfates. Dermatologist tested and non-comedogenic. Cruelty-free and vegan. 50 ml glass jar with a refill pod. Use a pea-sized amount morning and night after cleansing. Lasts 12 months after opening. Lots of customers tell us it cleared up their acne and eczema.

pages.text: Barrier Repair Daily Cream. Full ingredients: Aqua, Squalane, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Carbomer, Xanthan Gum, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin. In a 4-week study, 92% of people said their skin felt less tight. Rich cream that sinks in within a minute and leaves a soft, satin finish.
